data.body: Research note (session 2026-05-17, see docs/findings/code-review-fp-research-2026-05-17.md): This epic is structurally aligned with published abstention-threshold mechanisms — Spiess et al. ICSE 2025 ('Calibration and Correctness of Language Models for Code') argues for per-tier confidence thresholds with abstention below threshold rather than a single severity gate. The minor-finding ticket gate is the project-local analogue of abstention. Research-supported extension to consider when brainstorming: rather than a hardcoded maturity rubric, calibrate the rerouting threshold empirically using local Platt-scaling on observed FP rates per dimension/tier. Requires side-pane-tithe's telemetry substrate to be live — note as a soft dependency. Also: published consensus (LAURA, arXiv 2512.01356; Greptile production data) is that ~85% actionable signal is achievable with 2-3 weeks of human dismissal-feedback ingestion — the rerouted tickets here are a natural collection point for that feedback if you tag each ticket with the dismissal rationale, which then feeds back into prompt revisions.
